summary: Julong Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K on August 20, 2026, disclosing the resignation of independent director Shengshan Sun from the board and all three committees, effective the same day, and the appointment of Xitian Zhang as his replacement independent director and committee member. The filing attributes no disagreement to the departure; it is a routine, consensual board succession, not a forced or abrupt CEO/CFO exit. The board now has five members, two executive and three independent, with committee chairs unchanged. Director and indemnification agreements were executed. No transaction, price, or strategic event is present; no deal terms apply.
